title: Realization of finite-stage boundary evaluation on the pro-etale site
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\ge1$. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. All schemes below are $k$-schemes. Use ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories on small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], taken small in a larger universe [def-weil-size-convention]. On either site $D^b_{ctf}$ denotes bounded complexes with constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude: tensoring with any degree-zero module sheaf has cohomology in one fixed finite interval [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes, def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude].

Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. On etale sites write $s=i^*$ for exact constant-coefficient inverse image, $F=Ri_!=Ri_*$ for compact support [def-amb-etale-compact-support], and $G=i^\times$ for its ambient right adjoint [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], with counit $\mu:FG\to\mathrm{id}$. For the structure map $a_T:T\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ put $\omega_T=a_T^\times A$ and $\omega_Z=G\omega_T$. Set $D_W=R\mathcal Hom_A(-,\omega_W)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Write $\mathrm{ev}_H:D_WH\otimes_A^LH\to\omega_W$ for evaluation, $\sigma$ for signed tensor symmetry, and $\delta_H:H\to D_WD_WH$ for the transpose of $\mathrm{ev}_H\sigma_{H,D_WH}$ [lem-weil-duality-pairing].

Assume the etale $s,G,D_W$ preserve $D^b_{ctf}$ and etale $\delta_H$ is invertible on that category. Write $C_W=\nu_W^*$ for comparison [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback], $G_p=Ri_p^!=C_ZGR\nu_{T,*}$ for the specified exceptional functor [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], $F_p=Ri_{p,!}=Ri_{p,*}$ for the identity-open compactification [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification, def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], $\omega_{W,p}=Ra_{W,p}^!A$, and $D_{W,p}=R\mathcal Hom_A(-,\omega_{W,p})$.

The comparison $C_W$ is an equivalence on $D^b_{ctf}$ preserving and reflecting each Tor interval. Every pro-etale bounded finite-Tor constructible input has a bounded finite-Tor constructible etale representative. The specified $G_p$ and $i_p^*$ preserve $D^b_{ctf}$, and $G_pC_TN\cong C_ZGN$, $i_p^*C_TH\cong C_ZsH$. The exceptional Hom adjunction is defined on bounded-below etale-origin inputs; the identity-open compactification satisfies its dimension hypothesis.

Let $b^{\mathrm{dir}}_B:C_TFB\xrightarrow{\sim}F_pC_ZB$ be the canonical ordinary direct-image mate normalized by the ordinary pullback/direct-image counits [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate], and let $\eta_B=(b^{\mathrm{dir}}_B)^{-1}$. Let $\pi_e,\pi_p$ be the canonical ordinary-counit-defined projection maps $F_\tau B\otimes M\to F_\tau(B\otimes i_\tau^*M)$ [def-kun-projection-formula-map]. For $N\in D^b_{ctf}(T_e,A)$, $B\in D^b_c(Z_e,A)$ and $M\in D^b_{ctf}(T_e,A)$, the comparisons satisfy
$$\mu^p_{C_TN}=C_T(\mu_N)\eta_{GN},\qquad\eta_{B\otimes sM}\pi_p=C_T(\pi_e)(\eta_B\otimes1).$$
The projection maps here are invertible; their inverses correspond under the same comparisons.

There are evaluation-defined comparisons $w_W:C_W\omega_W\cong\omega_{W,p}$ and $\chi_{W,H}:C_WD_WH\cong D_{W,p}C_WH$ on all the finite-Tor inputs above, including their restrictions and iterated duals. The dualizing objects on both sites are themselves in $D^b_{ctf}$. These maps respect $G\omega_T\cong\omega_Z$ and identify evaluation and $\delta$. If $q^e$ and $q^p$ are the exceptional-adjunction transposes of projection-inverse followed by $1\otimes\mu$, the comparisons identify $q^p_{C_TM,C_TN}$ with $C_Zq^e_{M,N}$. For the etale data write $G_e=G$, $i_e^*=s$, $\omega_{W,e}=\omega_W$ and $D_{W,e}=D_W$. Let $h_e$ be the identity of $\omega_{Z,e}=G\omega_T$, and let $h_p:G_p\omega_{T,p}\cong\omega_{Z,p}$ be the canonical composition map of the specified exceptional inverse images. For $K,L\in D^b_{ctf}(T_\tau,A)$ define $\alpha_K^\tau$ as the tensor-Hom transpose of $h_\tau G_\tau(\mathrm{ev}_K\sigma_{K,D_{T,\tau}K})q^\tau_{K,D_{T,\tau}K}\sigma_{G_\tau D_{T,\tau}K,i_\tau^*K}$, and $\beta_L^\tau$ as the transpose of $h_\tau G_\tau(\mathrm{ev}_L)q^\tau_{D_{T,\tau}L,L}$. The comparisons identify these etale and pro-etale $\alpha,\beta$. In particular, under these named identifications any equality between the composites $\beta_{D_TK}\,i^*\delta_K$ and $D_Z(\alpha_K)\delta_{i^*K}$ on the etale site gives the identical equality on the pro-etale site, and invertibility of the etale $\alpha,\beta$ implies invertibility of their pro-etale versions.

Statement and stmt_deps are identical to the live node, which is still unsplit, so there is no parallel supersession; the re-split note is on the parent cor-weil-boundary-duality-discharge, and this item is one of its new nodes, so a plain split is right. Checked: no cycle (closure over 26491 nodes), every cited id exists, no SGA 4 regex hit, steps are 900 characters or less. Source: main-20261015 cor-weil-boundary-duality-discharge.proof.md, second paragraph (adjoint through tensor-Hom and i_* -| Ri^!, restriction of evaluation, compatibility of beta/alpha/delta); agent-written realization. Steps, each read against the cited statements: (1) constructible-origin (ii) plus tor-interval, whose test sheaves are arbitrary module sheaves and whose D^+ hypothesis holds for bounded complexes, gives the D^b_ctf equivalence. (2) The site-comparison unit gives o_N = C_Z G(j_N), matching the formula C_Z G Rnu_* of def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image; comparison-pullback gives the i^* comparison. (3) i is proper hence qcqs, so the canonical mate applies; etale-adjunction-restriction with c=(id,i) allows d=0 for empty Z; fully-faithful-hom-transport has the same G_p and o. (4) projection-comparison gives both displayed equalities; the finite-compact projection formula (B in D^b_c, M finite Tor) makes pi_e invertible, and pi_p is invertible directly from the square. (5) Closed monoidal unitors give D_T A = omega_T, which with G omega_T lies in D^b_ctf; dualizing-composition gives h_e and its unit transport h_p. (6) finite-duality-site-comparison (K finite Tor, omega in D^b_c) gives w and chi and identifies ev and delta; compatibility of h with w is a naturality square of units, accepted as elementary. (7) Every hypothesis of q-compatibility is met, and the factor order of alpha matches its displayed pairing; beta is covered by its 'every pairing' clause. (8) Elementary functoriality and inverses. Edge cases checked: Z empty, i=id, n=1, zero complexes. The worker-written tool_uses are accurate generic site-comparison and projection tools from other units and are accepted. No fixes.
